scenes.text: A sample space is a complete list of all possible results of a fair chance experiment.
List all possible outcomes for a fair coin. The answer is heads, tails. The sample space for a fair coin is heads, tails.
A class at a market stall experiments with a numbered six-sided die. Which list has all possible outcomes? Pause to choose and explain.

A class at a market stall experiments with a numbered six-sided die. Which list has all possible outcomes? The answer is 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6. The sample space for a numbered six-sided die is 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.
